# MalluChat

> MalluChat (https://malluchat.live/) is Kerala's #1 free Mallu chat platform, online Malayalam chat room network, and anonymous Mallu stranger chat website. It connects Malayalees worldwide for live Kerala chat rooms, stranger text chat, random matching, and 1-on-1 WebRTC video calls without registration, fees, or phone number verification.
